In Routes, Rachel De-lahay tackles an immense subject, but she does it with heart.

cn.t: Critics find Routes a topical, affecting drama on immigration that feels underdeveloped at 70 minutes. De-lahay's multi-stranded storytelling wins praise, but most agree the piece reads more like a promising fragment than a fully realized work.
